candidate.description:
Dishaank enables citizens to easily identify the survey number of any location within Karnataka using mobile GPS.
The app also allows citizens to access detailed land information, including ownership, survey boundaries and Hissa boundaries.

Developed by the Karnataka State Remote Sensing Applications Centre (KSRSAC), Dishaank promotes transparency and simplifies access to land records across the state.

Key Features:
* Identify survey/Hissa numbers using your current GPS location
* View land ownership details
* Legend view for map description
* Search by district, taluk, hobli, village, and survey number
* Weather widget: tap any location to view current weather and 3-day forecast
* Measurement tools to calculate land area and distances
* Go to latitude/longitude function for precise location navigation
* Simple and user-friendly map interface

Disclaimer:
Data provided in Dishaank is for information purposes only and not legally valid for ownership or boundary confirmation.

candidate.description:
Kaveri Travels is a renowned brand in the bus operating industry. Our vision is to give a new face to the bus industry. Since our inception passenger comfort was our top priority. We have frequently added luxury buses to our huge fleet of buses. The only thing we focus on is that the comfort quotient of our passengers should never be compromised. We have always tried our best to push our limits in order to develop our travel experience. Read further to understand what we offer that enhances our reputation in the market.

Live Bus Tracking
We have integrated this great technology of live bus tracking in almost all of our buses. This helps the passengers to be informed about the live position of the bus, thus helping them in planning their commute to the bus stand. It also prevents the unwanted stress of missing or waiting for the bus in case of delays.

Our Customer Support
To render the best service we strive to provide the best customer support. We have an attentive customer support team to which the passengers can report any issues regarding the journey. This team addresses all the issues of the passengers and comes out with a solution in the shortest possible time. This creates a warm feeling in the customers thus pushing them to be our regular customers.

Great Comfort

Our luxurious fleet includes Mercedes Benz Multi-axle buses, Volvo Multi-axle buses, and Scania Multi-axle comfort buses. These buses help in smoothening the journey. Our motto to change the perception of bus travel makes us enhance our luxury levels regularly.

Safety
Safety is one of the most important criteria we look for while planning a bus route. We have the best drivers who completely understand the importance of safety and follow all the safety rules.

Regular Offers
We at K Kaveri Travels strive to maintain the most reasonable rates in the market. This also makes our passengers happy and thus we further give them discount offers on a regular basis to enhance their happiness.

candidate.description:
English
Kirjoituskaveri is a simple everyday app for speaking, writing, translating, and remembering. It helps you create messages, reminders, and shopping lists by voice or keyboard, all in one clear and easy-to-use app.

With Kirjoituskaveri, you can speak instead of typing, translate between Finnish and English, and listen to text aloud when reading is easier by audio. You can also copy, share, and save messages, so important text is always easy to find again.

The app includes a simple calendar for reminders and events, including repeating reminders for routines, appointments, and everyday tasks. You can also keep a shopping list and add items by speaking or typing.

Kirjoituskaveri is designed to make everyday life easier with a calm interface, clear navigation, and support in both Finnish and English.

Features:

Voice-to-text messaging
Finnish and English translation
Text-to-speech playback
Message history, copy, and sharing
Calendar and reminders
Recurring reminders
Shopping lists by voice or typing
Optional daily wellbeing prompts
Simple bilingual interface
Kirjoituskaveri is a practical helper for anyone who wants an easier way to manage communication and daily routines.

Finnish
Kirjoituskaveri on helppo sovellus arjen puhumiseen, kirjoittamiseen, kääntämiseen ja muistamiseen. Sen avulla voit tehdä viestejä, muistutuksia ja ostoslistoja puheella tai näppäimistöllä samassa selkeässä sovelluksessa.

Kirjoituskaverilla voit puhua kirjoittamisen sijaan, kääntää tekstiä suomen ja englannin välillä sekä kuunnella tekstiä ääneen. Voit myös kopioida, jakaa ja tallentaa viestejä, jotta tärkeät asiat löytyvät helposti myöhemmin.

Sovelluksessa on selkeä kalenteri muistutuksille ja tapahtumille. Voit luoda myös toistuvia muistutuksia rutiineihin, tapaamisiin ja muihin arjen tehtäviin. Lisäksi voit pitää ostoslistaa ja lisätä tuotteita puhumalla tai kirjoittamalla.

Kirjoituskaveri on suunniteltu helpottamaan arkea rauhallisella käyttöliittymällä, selkeällä navigoinnilla sekä suomen- ja englanninkielisellä tuella.

Ominaisuudet:

Puheesta tekstiksi
Käännökset suomen ja englannin välillä
Tekstin kuuntelu ääneen
Viestihistoria, kopiointi ja jakaminen
Kalenteri ja muistutukset
Toistuvat muistutukset
Ostoslistat puhumalla tai kirjoittamalla
Valinnaiset päivittäiset hyvinvointimuistutukset
Selkeä kaksikielinen käyttöliittymä
Kirjoituskaveri sopii kaikille, jotka haluavat helpomman tavan hoitaa arjen viestintää ja muistettavia asioita.

candidate.description:
HINGE, DESIGNED TO BE DELETED
Hinge is the dating app for people who want to get off of dating apps. With profiles that show your personality through text, photos, video, and voice, you have unique conversations that lead to great dates. 

HOW WE GET YOU OFF HINGE
When it comes to online dating, people are so busy matching that they’re not actually connecting, in person, where it counts. Hinge is on a mission to change that. So we built an app that’s designed to be deleted. Here’s how:

* We quickly learn your type. You’ll only be introduced to the best people for you.

* We give you a sense of someone’s personality. You’ll get to know potential dates through their unique answers to prompts, as well as information like religion, height, politics, dating intentions, relationship type, and much more.

* We make it easy to start a conversation. Every match begins by someone liking or commenting on a specific part of your profile.

* We want you to feel confident about meeting people in person. Selfie Verification makes it easier for daters on Hinge to ensure that they are who they say they are.

* We ask how your dates are going. After exchanging phone numbers with a Match, we’ll follow up to hear how your date went so we can make better recommendations in the future.

The app is free to use. Members looking to see everyone who likes them or send unlimited likes can upgrade to Hinge+. To access additional features, including enhanced recommendations and priority likes, we offer HingeX.
